pathBase: All asset path, originalPath and sourcePaths fields are relative to the NewProject repository root. generationHistory.generatedResultPath and absolute referencePaths are archival machine-local provenance, not distributed outputs.

Production game background for a daytime hospital exploration district in an orthographic high-angle refined 2D pixel-art survival game. Show a readable main road, hospital entrance, ambulance search zone, fenced contamination pocket, purifier station, rescue point, two route branches, indoor entrance, and a clearly reserved ark-return edge. Warm-yellow interactive objects must be visible in the environment without UI markers. No HUD, no text, no icons, no characters, no monsters, no route overlay, no baked collision markings, no isometric view, no side view, no 3D realism. Reference image 2: main gameplay screenshot, use only environment pixel density, camera and edge treatment; exclude all UI and actors. Treat the hospital's architecture as environment, not a diagram. Use unlettered architecture and unmarked props.

Four clear environmental interactables, distributed in unobscured area: yellow search magnifier marker and warm yellow ground ring around ambulance bay; yellow gear/purify marker and ring on purifier tank upper middle; an actual seated injured survivor at the roadside medical tent, with warm yellow rescue-person marker/ring, visibly distinct from combat enemies; warm yellow doorway marker and ground bracket at hospital front entrance. Keep this world marker above the right action buttons and below the minimap. All interaction markers warm yellow; threat magenta; navigation cyan. No full-screen regional overview, no location-selection panel, no departure confirmation button, no large text blocks, no decorative title, no watermark, no mockup device frame. This is a full-bleed gameplay screenshot. Maintain map topology and visual style.
